categories.main_business_segments: Celsius Holdings operates primarily in the functional energy drink and liquid supplement categories, with its flagship CELSIUS® brand. The company also offers protein bars and, through its Func Food subsidiary, markets additional beverages, supplements, and superfoods in Nordic countries under brands such as FAST, FitFarm, and CocoVi.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Celsius products are based on a proprietary thermogenic MetaPlus® formulation, designed to accelerate metabolism and burn calories. The company emphasizes clinically proven formulas, with multiple published studies supporting product efficacy. Manufacturing is outsourced to third-party co-packers, with Celsius supplying most ingredients and all packaging materials, ensuring quality and consistency across multiple production sites.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Celsius serves a broad range of consumers, including fitness enthusiasts and health-conscious individuals. Key customer channels include supermarkets, convenience stores, drug stores, mass merchants, health clubs, gyms, military outlets, and e-commerce platforms such as Amazon and Walmart.com. The company also has a presence in specialty nutrition and vitamin stores.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary market is North America, especially the United States, with growing international operations in Europe (notably Sweden and Finland), Asia (mainly China via a licensing agreement), and other select regions. International sales accounted for approximately 6% of consolidated net sales in 2022, with the majority of revenue generated in the U.S.
categories.supply_chain_position: Celsius operates as a downstream company, focusing on product development, marketing, and distribution. It outsources manufacturing to third-party co-packers and manages distribution through direct-store delivery (DSD), direct-to-retailer (DTR), and partnerships with major distributors, most notably PepsiCo in the U.S.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding distribution, especially through its partnership with PepsiCo, increasing brand awareness, and driving innovation in functional beverages. Celsius invests in clinical research to substantiate product claims and regularly introduces new flavors, product lines, and packaging formats to meet evolving consumer preferences, with a focus on health, wellness, and natural ingredients.
categories.revenue_model: Celsius generates revenue primarily through the sale of ready-to-drink functional energy beverages, powdered supplements, and protein bars. Revenue streams include direct sales to retailers, distributors, and e-commerce platforms, as well as royalties from international licensing agreements (notably in China).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Celsius competes in the highly competitive functional energy drink and supplement market against major global brands such as Red Bull, Monster Energy, The Coca-Cola Company, Dr. Pepper Snapple Group, and Nestlé, as well as private label and regional brands. The company differentiates itself through clinically substantiated product claims and a focus on health-oriented, clean-label ingredients.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Celsius reported $653.6 million in revenue, representing 108% year-over-year growth, driven primarily by North American expansion and increased distribution. The company has experienced rapid growth in recent years, supported by significant investments in marketing and distribution, and ended 2022 with $614 million in cash and 378 employees globally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Celsius emphasizes its clinically proven, proprietary MetaPlus® formula, which is designed to burn calories, accelerate metabolism, and provide sustained energy without artificial preservatives, aspartame, or high fructose corn syrup. The brand positions itself as a healthier, science-backed alternative to traditional energy drinks, appealing to fitness enthusiasts and health-conscious consumers seeking functional benefits.
